about: Accepted differences between nuBuilder and nuBuilder Next for dev/tests/compat.js. kind: value (edit form field), cell (browse cell id), column (table column after a save). form / field: regex (* = any form). nub / next: optional regex the two values must match. Every entry needs a reason.

known.reason: helper elements of the page (Tom Select search box, file upload parts) – not a field value
nuBuilder Next: format option 'negative' = brackets / red_brackets (Formats page) – nuBuilder has no such option and shows a minus
nuBuilder Next shows the suffix of a number format (1000.0 %) – nuBuilder drops it
input mask of the field: nuBuilder Forte shows the stored value when the record opens, nuBuilder Next the masked one (the saved value is the same) – open point in TODO.md, to be decided

ticket sample: the browse SQL has joins and OR conditions, so nuBuilder Forte's git HEAD wraps it as complex SQL and ignores its ORDER BY t.created_at DESC (other order of the same tickets); nuBuilder Next keeps the order – open point in TODO.md

test kit form with complex browse SQL: nuBuilder Forte's git HEAD (23559e7, "complex SQL in Browse Forms") shows no rows – a nuBuilder Forte problem, nuBuilder Next shows the records; open point in TODO.md
